notes.problem: Weather chip next to the sun icon. Quang is not a weather word; clear sky is quang đãng.
BÀO is a membrane/cell fragment, not spore. The full button BÀO TỬ is the right word. Short is what a narrow HUD would show.
Dọn dẹp is the verb to clean up, not the cleaner noun. Fungi nấm is right.
Kẻ often means a villain, not a neutral eater. Same kẻ on consumer2.
Same kẻ tone on the mid eater chip.
TUYỆT CHỦNG is the noun extinction. The death title is the extinct state.
Bạn is polite-neutral. The other toasts have no pronoun. Informal game lines drop it.
notes.fix: Là cây: bơi về phía sáng

notes.problem: 먹 is a cut-off stem, not a word. The eat button text is taken from the short key, so players see 먹 instead of 먹기.
하는 법 is how to do it, not how to play. Menu button.
ร้อน is hot, not summer. Spring and autumn next to it are real season names.
หนาว is cold, not winter.
ตัวเก็บกวาด (เชื้อรา) is 17 graphemes and wraps the species chip. Cleaners and fungi are the right ideas.
notes.fix: ตัวกวาด (เชื้อรา)

notes.problem: NAUBOS means used up or ran out, not extinct.
ULIT is only again, vague on the death button.
PAHINTO is the command pause it. The overlay title is the status paused.
singaw alone is steam or vapor, not fungi. Fungi is halamang-singaw. Do not shorten that to singaw.
lawa is a lake. English is a pond cross-section. Hiwa (a cut) is fine.
notes.fix: Simulasyon ng mikrobyo — 100 uri + virus. Hiwa ng pond.

notes.problem: Same lake word on the wiki title.
SETTINGS is still English. Casual arrange/settings is ayos. Title settingsT is also still English Settings.
Settings title left in English.
Normal is untranslated.
cyst is left in English, so spore SPORA and the encysted state are not a local pair. Do not use sista (reads as sister).
notes.fix: Gutom: nakakulong — maghanap ng pagkain at gumising

notes.problem: PAANO MAGLARO is 13 characters on a small menu button. English HOW TO PLAY is 11. May wrap.
Maliliit na kumakain is 20 characters and wraps the species chip. kumakain is the right eater idea.
Mga gitnang kumakain is 20 characters on the same chip.
Malalaking mangangaso is 21 characters. Do not shorten mangangaso to aso (that is dog).
COME GIOCARE is 12 characters on the small menu button. English HOW TO PLAY is 11.
Fame is hunger and collides with the hunger toast. Starved is a death cause.
Mangiatori piccoli is 18 characters and wraps the 160px species chip. consumer2 is 15. Do not drop mangiatori; there is no shorter accurate eater noun.
Zjedzone is the same passive as the death cause Eaten, not the active Ate. Reads as you were eaten. Masculine player address, same as the Ukrainian toast.
USTAWIENIA is 10 characters. Settings button budget that failed German was 8. Title settingsT can stay Ustawienia.
Głód is hunger and collides with the hunger toast. Starved is a death cause.
НАЛАШТУВАННЯ is 12 Cyrillic capitals. It overflows the settings button. Title settingsT can stay Налаштування.
ПРОДОВЖИТИ is the infinitive and 10 letters. Pause button. Informal imperative is shorter and is the right register.
Поділись is the perfective share command. The divide button is ДІЛИ, and Поділ is already the division noun. Поділись: 1/3 reads as share.
Голод is hunger and collides with the hunger toast. Starved is a death cause.
囊胞 is Japanese-style. A Taiwan microbe cyst is 包囊. Spore 孢子 is already the right distinct word.
notes.fix: 餓了：變成包囊 — 找食物再醒來

notes.problem: 吃貨 is foodie slang, not the trophic eater. Same slang on consumer2. Informal, but the glossary noun is 食者.
Same foodie slang on the mid eater chip.
Makan is the same imperative as the Eat button, not the past confirmation Ate.
Bunga means flower, not spring. The season chip will read as Flower.
Panas is hot, not summer.
Sejuk is cold, not winter. Luruh for autumn can stay.
MULA SEMULA is 11 characters. Restart button. English RESTART is 7.
ভাগ is share or a portion. Cell division elsewhere in this file is বিভাজন (divs). ভাগ: 1/3 reads as share.
Same share-word on the short HUD label. বিভাজন is 4 graphemes and fits the short budget.
Goal line ভাগ reads as share, not divide. Inconsistent with divs বিভাজন.
ভাগ হচ্ছে is being shared. The dividing toast should use the division noun.
Same share-verb on the blocked toast.
Busy reason ভাগ হচ্ছে is being shared, not dividing.
বন্ধ is closed or off, not the close command. Informal তুমি is already used in the toasts.
সে is the pronoun he or she, not seconds. অপেক্ষা 3 সে reads as a wait and then he, not a cooldown.
চালিয়ে যাও is the right continue phrase but wide on the pause button. চালাও is the short run-it resume. Do not use a share-word.
